reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Works, but not acceptable upstream as written
summary: For an input without a separate display element, the date formatter now returns YYYY-MM-DD before it looks at the dateFormat option, so focusing no longer rewrites a saved ISO value.
caveats: Every input datepicker now shows ISO dates and ignores a configured dateFormat, including a custom formatter function.
The pending human fixes keep the configured format and separate the displayed text from the submitted value; this patch does not.
